intro.title: Design Real-Time Dashboard
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a real-time dashboard that displays live data updates, such as stock prices or user activity. You will learn how to use Vue's reactive state system to automatically update the UI when data changes. The main technologies involved are Vue components, reactive data properties, and conditional rendering. This beginner-friendly project will help you understand how to create dynamic, data-driven interfaces in Vue.
intro.usecase: Real-time dashboards are essential in modern applications where live data visualization drives decision-making. Developers implement these patterns in financial trading platforms that display stock price fluctuations, operations centers monitoring server health metrics, and logistics systems tracking delivery vehicles on interactive maps. These dashboards typically combine live data feeds with interactive charts, status indicators, and filtering controls that update without page refreshes. Mastering this pattern enables you to build responsive monitoring tools, analytics interfaces, and live reporting systems that users rely on for up-to-the-second information.
